senses.gloss: द्रङ्ग draṅga, m., ā, f. town.
द्रढिक draḍh-ika, m. N. of a man.
द्रधस् drádh-as, n. garment.

द्रम् DRAM, Ⅰ. P. dráma, run or wander 🞄about;
 intv. dandramya, id..
द्रम्म dramma (δραχμή), a coin = sixpence.
द्रवत् drav-át (pr. pt. of √ dru), ad. swiftly.
द्रवय drava-ya, Ā. run, flow.
द्रवर drava-rá, a. running swiftly.

द्रविड draviḍa, m. N. of a country on the 🞄west coast of the Deccan;
 son of a Vrātya or 🞄degraded Kṣatriya: pl. the inhabitants of 🞄the Draviḍa country.
द्रविणोद draviṇo-dá, ˚दस् -dás, ˚दा -dā́, 🞄a. bestowing wealth.
द्रवित्नु drav-i-tnú, a. swift.
द्रवीभू dravī-bhū, become fluid.
द्रव्य 1. drav-ya, a. arboreal (v. dru).

द्रा 2. DRĀ, Ⅱ. P. drā-ti, Ⅳ. drāyá, sleep. 🞄ni, P. Ā. fall asleep, slumber: pr. pt. nidrāṇa, sleeping;
 pp. nidrita, id..
द्राक् drāk, ad. [n. of drā‿añc, running towards], 🞄instantly.
द्राक्ष drākṣa, a. made of grapes.

द्राक्षा drākṣā, f. vine;
 grape: -rasa, m. 🞄grape-juice.

द्राघय drāgha-ya, den. P. prolong;
 delay.

द्राघिमन् drāgh-i-mán, m. length;
 -iṣṭha, 🞄spv., -īyas, cpv. of dīrgha.

द्रावण drāv-aṇa, a. putting to flight;
 n. id..
द्रावयत्सख drāvayát-sakha, a. speeding his 🞄companion, i. e. his rider.
द्रावयितृ drāv-ayi-tṛ, m. who causes to run.
द्रावयित्नु drāv-ay-i-tnú, a. melting.
